key_line.metric: program EACs (GEM 63XL, SiAW) and segment margins
key_line.detail: The release names no GEM 63XL or SiAW charge in Q3; Space margin 11.3% (up from 11.0%) meets the 'north of 11%' H2 promise; Defense Systems 10.8% (down from 11.4%, attributed to mix toward cost-type work). Net awards $16.4bn, book-to-bill 1.5x, backlog $109.6bn record.

guidance.detail: FY2026 MTM-adj EPS $29.35-29.75 (from $28.60-29.10, +$0.70 at midpoint); segment OI $4.94-5.04bn (from $4.85-5.00bn); sales $43.75-44.25bn and adj FCF $3.1-3.5bn unchanged. Segment guide: Space low-10% margin, Defense ~10%, Mission mid-15% (from ~15%). No 2027/2028 figures in the release; CEO refers to a 2027 outlook, presumably for the call.

call.detail: Webcast at 09:30 ET, coincident with the open. The promised 2027-28 cash-flow / capex outlook (hunt finding i4) is likely to land on it; sign uncertain, and this name has been sold on calls after beats (Q2 2026 -2.2%, Q1 2026 -7.0%).

public_reaction.summary: No press, analyst or retail coverage of the Q3 2026 print was indexed by search as of ~09:00 ET; the only reaction evidence is the tape: pre-market spiked to +3.8% (high 530.20) and faded to +1.0% by 08:48.

tape_read.note: +0.98% at 08:48 against a 3.86% implied move and a ~10% EPS beat with a $0.70 guide raise. The pre-market high (+3.8%) shows the first read was near the implied move and it was sold back, consistent with this name's habit of selling beats (Q2 -2.2%, Q1 -7.0%). Bars carry no volume. On paper the release supports more than +1%; the fade says sellers are present, so 'undershoot' is a low-confidence read.

thesis_check.note: The short rested on a third GEM 63XL / SiAW charge and a downside-leaning cash update. The release shows no named charge, Space margin above 11%, a ~10% EPS beat and a raised EPS and segment-OI guide. Only remaining short-side hooks: Defense margin 10.8% (below the 11% H2 hope), FCF guide not raised, and the 2027 outlook still to come on the call.

recommendation.reason: De cijfers spreken de short-these tegen: winst per aandeel ruim 9% boven verwachting, jaarprognose verhoogd en geen nieuwe programmakosten op GEM 63XL of SiAW. Het aandeel staat voorbeurs nog maar ongeveer 1% hoger na een piek van bijna 4%, dus de positie verliest nu weinig; de telefonische toelichting begint om 09:30 met mogelijk een 2027-vooruitzicht, en dat is een risico in beide richtingen dat we niet hoeven te dragen. Dek de short bij de opening.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als de voorbeurskoers voor 09:30 terugzakt tot onder het slot van gisteren (rond 510) of nieuwsberichten over een zwak 2027-kasstroomvooruitzicht verschijnen, is vasthouden tot 13:00 (de standaardregel) verdedigbaar.
